specs.title: computer windows release hidden content and reuse the bounded physical preview
production gameplay: room, shop, purchase, manual rip/swipes, collection and persistent refresh
settings reset requires confirmation, handles failure, clears progress and stays reset after refresh
production hidden shortcuts add one persistent special pack per press and open through normal gameplay
physical safe crack preserves the same card and survives reloading
physical damaged crack preserves the same card and survives reloading
reload during slab animation cannot undo or reroll a failed crack
close during slab animation cannot undo or reroll a failed crack
persistent missing stock, creases, dents and scratches render on the real two-sided card
